_comment: PLACEHOLDER descriptor of the rev A coil coupon (default slot S4, wide). The board is not designed: these values follow SPEC §4.5 and §4.8's plan and are to be replaced from its captured design. Images made from this file carry the placeholder flag.
notes: SPEC §4.8: about 20 generated coils, five LDC1614-class converters, a local 40 MHz reference; AN0 for a thermistor if fitted; G0-G4 drive the converters' ADDR pins (§4.5: hold the selected one low, the others high, talk only to 0x2A); INTB outputs wired-OR on IRQ_N
the LDC1614 addresses 0x2A / 0x2B are SPEC §4.5's, marked unverified there
G4 is a slow expander line on S1-S4, fine for a static select (SPEC §4.8)

AN0.note: if fitted; buffered so the lane sees a stiff source
